test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are 100 students in a hostel. Food provisions for them will last for 20 days. How long will the same provisions last if 25 more students join the hostel?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial number of students = 100

Food provisions last for = 20 days

Number of students after joining = 100 + 25 = 125

**Formula used:**

Provisions per student per day = Total provisions / (Initial number of students × Number of days)
